title: SEP-1330: Elicitation Enum Schema Improvements and Standards Compliance
excerpt: SEP 1330: Elicitation Enum Schema Improvements and Standards Compliance Status : Final Type : Standards Track Created : 2025 08 11 Author(s) : chughtapan Issue : 1330 Abstract This SEP proposes improvements to enum schema definitions in MCP, deprecating the non standard enumNames property in favor of JSON Schema compliant patterns, and introducing additional support for multi select enum schemas in addition to single choice schemas. The new schemas have been validated against the JSON specification. Schema Changes:...
headings: SEP-1330: Elicitation Enum Schema Improvements and Standards Compliance
1. Mark Current EnumSchema with Non-Standard enumNames Property as "Legacy"
2. Define Single Selection Enums (with Titled and Untitled varieties)
3. Introduce Multiple Selection Enums (with Titled and Untitled varieties)
